thread.title: Universal Display Corp. (OLED) Is Up Sharply On Apple News

author: nasdaq.com
title: Universal Display Corp. (OLED) Is Up Sharply On Apple News
text:
Shutterstock photo
(RTTNews.com) - Universal Display Corp. (OLED) has gapped open sharply higher Tuesday morning after a report from South Korea's Electronic Times. According to the report, Apple ( AAPL ) will use Universal Display's screens in their new iPhone.
Universal Display gapped open sharply higher this morning, but has since pared its early gains. Shares are now up 11.20 at $110.85. The stock has jumped to over a 2-month high.
